question.text:
A function $F(A, B, C)$ defined by three Boolean variables $A, B$ and $C$ when expressed as sum of products is given by

$$
F=\bar{A} \cdot \bar{B} \cdot \bar{C}+\bar{A} \cdot B \cdot \bar{C}+A \cdot \bar{B} \cdot \bar{C}
$$

where, $\bar{A}, \bar{B}$ and $\bar{C}$ are complements of the respective variable. The product of sums (POS) form of the function $F$ is

  1. $F=(A+B+C) \cdot(A+\tilde{B}+C) \cdot(\bar{A}+B+C)$
     
  2. $F=(\bar{A}+\bar{B}+\bar{C}) \cdot(\bar{A}+B+\bar{C}) \cdot(A+\bar{B}+\bar{C})$
     
  3. $F=(A+B+\bar{C}) \cdot(A+\bar{B}+\bar{C}) \cdot(\bar{A}+B+\bar{C}) \cdot(\bar{A}+\bar{B}+C) \cdot(\bar{A}+\bar{B}+\bar{C})$
     
  4. $F=(\bar{A}+\bar{B}+C) \cdot(\bar{A}+B+C) \cdot(A+B+\bar{C}) \cdot(A+B+C)$
question.subject: Programming in C

question.text:
Select the Boolean function(s) equivalent to $x+y z$, where $x, y$, and $z$ are Boolean variables, and + denotes logical OR operation.

  1. $x+z+x y$
     
  2. $(x+y)(x+z)$
     
  3. $x+x y+y z$
     
  4. $x+x z+x y$
